name: solar installer loan plan
instructions: Write a business plan for a bank loan application. Business: Jua Bora Ltd, rooftop solar installer in Arusha, Tanzania, since 2021; 340 installations; 12 technicians; average job TZS 3.2M. Ask: TZS 80M loan to open a branch in Moshi. Include a 3-year projection.
input: Owner notes: margins about 28%. Main competitors are two Nairobi-based firms with local agents. We want the branch open by March.

rubric: Executive summary states the TZS 80M ask and its use
Uses the client's figures (340 installs, 12 technicians, TZS 3.2M average job, 28% margin)
3-year financial projection table with visible arithmetic
Assumptions labelled as assumptions
Risks section

name: mobile food kiosk
instructions: Write a short business plan (about 1,200 words) for a chapati and tea kiosk near the University of Dodoma, aimed at a SACCO loan of TZS 5M. Keep it simple.
input: Startup costs: kiosk TZS 2.5M, equipment TZS 1.5M, first stock TZS 1M. Expected 250 customers a day at TZS 1,500 average.

rubric: Short plan suited to a SACCO
Uses the startup costs and customer figures given
Simple monthly revenue and cost estimate
Clear repayment discussion

name: plan in swahili
instructions: Andika mpango wa biashara kwa Kiswahili kwa ajili ya kikundi cha wanawake wanaotengeneza sabuni ya asili mjini Tanga. Wanahitaji TZS 12M kununua mashine.
input: Wanachama 15. Wanauza vipande 3,000 kwa mwezi kwa TZS 1,200 kila kimoja.

rubric: Written in Swahili
Uses members, volume and price given
States the TZS 12M need and use
Includes simple financial projection

name: investor pitch plan for agritech
instructions: Write an investor-oriented business plan for MkulimaPay, a mobile app that lets smallholder farmers in Kenya buy inputs on credit repaid at harvest. Seeking USD 250k seed.
input: Pilot: 1,800 farmers in Nakuru, 92% repayment, average loan USD 85. Team of 4 (2 engineers, 1 agronomist, 1 ops).

rubric: Investor framing with the USD 250k ask and use of funds
Uses pilot metrics (1,800 farmers, 92% repayment, USD 85)
Market and competition with named alternatives
Risks including credit risk
Milestones

name: client-specified structure wins
instructions: Write a business plan for a tailoring workshop in Mwanza using exactly these four sections: 1. Overview 2. Customers 3. Money 4. Next steps. Under 800 words.
input: Two tailors, sells school uniforms; 600 uniforms last year at TZS 25,000.

rubric: Exactly the four requested sections in order
Under 800 words
Uses the 600 uniforms and TZS 25,000 figures
